app.name: Fly by Sound
cue.safety.wall.name: Wall
cue.safety.wall.glossary: A short wooden knock, coming from where the wall is. The closer you get, the faster the knocks.
cue.safety.floor.name: Floor
cue.safety.floor.glossary: A low, soft thud from below. It speeds up when you sink toward the ground.
cue.safety.ceiling.name: Ceiling
cue.safety.ceiling.glossary: A light puff of air from above. It speeds up when you climb toward the ceiling.
cue.safety.obstacle.name: Obstacle
cue.safety.obstacle.glossary: A bright metal tick from the direction of a pillar or a bar. Steer away from it.
cue.safety.touch.name: Touch
cue.safety.touch.glossary: One short ping when you bump into something. A bump is soft: nothing breaks.
cue.safety.reset.name: Re-centre
cue.safety.reset.glossary: A quick sweep that tells you the drone was put back at the last checkpoint.
cue.height.tone.name: Height tone
cue.height.tone.glossary: A steady, soft tone. The higher you fly, the higher the tone.
cue.height.rough.name: Buzzing height
cue.height.rough.glossary: When the height tone buzzes, you are too high or too low for this lesson.
cue.speed.tick.name: Speed ticks
cue.speed.tick.glossary: Soft ticks, like a clock. The faster you fly, the faster they tick.
cue.target.hum.name: Target hum
cue.target.hum.glossary: A low, warm hum from the middle of the next gate. Fly toward it. It repeats faster as you get close.
cue.target.off.name: Off course
cue.target.off.glossary: When the hum turns rough, you are not lined up with the gate. When it is smooth again, you are.
cue.target.note.name: Gate note
cue.target.note.glossary: A bright note each time you pass a gate. The notes climb like a little song.
cue.target.lap.name: Lap chime
cue.target.lap.glossary: The last note finishes the song. It means the whole lap is done.
cue.target.checkpoint.name: Checkpoint
cue.target.checkpoint.glossary: A short double chime when you reach a checkpoint.
cue.target.fanfare.name: Fanfare
cue.target.fanfare.glossary: A happy little fanfare when you pass a step.
cue.shape.ring.name: Ring
cue.shape.ring.glossary: A sound that circles around you, like a ring. The closer the ring, the wider it circles.
cue.shape.square.name: Square
cue.shape.square.glossary: A sound that runs along four sides and ticks at every corner.
cue.shape.cube.name: Cube
cue.shape.cube.glossary: A sound that jumps between a front frame and a back frame, one after the other.
cue.shape.pillar.name: Pillar
cue.shape.pillar.glossary: A sound that sweeps up and down along a tall pillar.
cue.room.bed.name: Room
cue.room.bed.glossary: A soft background that opens up in big spaces and closes in tight ones.

theme.soft.name: Soft
theme.soft.what: Gentle mallets and pads. This is the usual choice.
theme.clear.name: Clear
theme.clear.what: Clean tones and clicks, like a parking sensor.
theme.race.name: Race
theme.race.what: Short, sharp sounds for fast flying.
lesson.ears-headphones.title: Headphone check
lesson.ears-headphones.intro.1: Let's check your headphones. Wired headphones work best, and the volume should be comfortable, never loud.
lesson.ears-headphones.intro.2: You will hear a sound on the left, then on the right, then behind you. Answer with the number keys.
lesson.ears-headphones.goal.1: Tell me where each sound is.
lesson.ears-headphones.pass: Your headphones work well. You are ready for the next step.
lesson.ears-headphones.hint.1: Check that the plug is all the way in, and that each side is on the right ear.
lesson.ears-glossary.title: Meet the sounds
lesson.ears-glossary.intro.1: In this lesson you meet every sound you will hear while flying.
lesson.ears-glossary.intro.2: I name each one and play it. You do not have to remember them all at once.
lesson.ears-glossary.pass: Now you know the sounds. Each one comes back in a lesson.
lesson.ears-glossary.hint.1: Don't try to learn them all at once. Each sound comes back when you need it.
lesson.ears-walls.title: Walls on every side
lesson.ears-walls.intro.1: A wall makes short wooden knocks. The nearer it is, the faster they come.
lesson.ears-walls.intro.2: Now a wall will come toward you from each side in turn. I will tell you where it comes from.
lesson.ears-walls.goal.1: Listen to where each wall comes from.
lesson.ears-walls.pass: You heard walls from every side.
lesson.ears-walls.hint.1: The knocks come from the side where the wall is. A floor sounds low, and a ceiling sounds airy.
lesson.ears-shapes.title: Ring, square and pillar
lesson.ears-shapes.intro.1: Objects have their own sounds. A ring circles around you. A square ticks at its corners. A pillar sweeps up and down.
lesson.ears-shapes.intro.2: Each one will come closer. Listen to how it grows around you.
lesson.ears-shapes.goal.1: Listen to the ring, the square and the pillar.
lesson.ears-shapes.pass: You have met all three shapes.
lesson.ears-shapes.hint.1: A wider circle of sound means the ring is closer.
lesson.ears-game.title: What is it, and where?
lesson.ears-game.intro.1: Here is a little game. I play a sound. You tell me what it is, where it is, and whether it is moving.
lesson.ears-game.intro.2: Answer with the number keys, or say the number. If you are not sure, just guess.
lesson.ears-game.intro.3: This game never stops you from going on. You can skip it at any time.
lesson.ears-game.pass: Great ears! You know the sounds.
lesson.ears-game.hint.1: Listen to the colour of the sound: knock, thud, puff, ring or tick.
lesson.hover-height.title: Hold your height
lesson.hover-height.intro.1: Now you fly, but gently. The drone levels itself, so you only choose how high it is.
lesson.hover-height.intro.2: The tone you hear is your height. A higher tone means higher up. A smooth tone means the right height, and a buzzing tone means too high or too low.
lesson.hover-height.goal.1: Keep the tone smooth for {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
lesson.hover-height.pass: You held your height. That is the first skill of flying by ear.
lesson.hover-height.retry: Let's try again, with small moves.
lesson.hover-height.hint.1: If the tone buzzes and is high, come down a little. If it buzzes and is low, go up.
lesson.hover-turn.title: Turn toward a sound
lesson.hover-turn.intro.1: A sound will come from one side. Turn until it is straight ahead.
lesson.hover-turn.intro.2: When the sound is in front of you, it is exactly in the middle between your two ears.
lesson.hover-turn.goal.1: Turn until you face the sound.
lesson.hover-turn.hint.1: If the sound is on your left, turn left. Stop turning when it comes to the middle.
lesson.move-speed.title: Feel your speed
lesson.move-speed.intro.1: Now you will move. Soft ticks tell you your speed. Faster ticks mean faster flying.
lesson.move-speed.intro.2: Fly forward a little, then let go of the stick. The drone slows down and stops.
lesson.move-speed.goal.1: Fly forward, then slow down and stop.
lesson.move-speed.retry: Let's try again, nice and slow.
lesson.move-speed.hint.1: When the ticks slow down and stop, you have stopped.
lesson.move-stop.title: Stop in the zone
lesson.move-stop.intro.1: A zone is waiting ahead of you, about {metres, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}} away.
lesson.move-stop.intro.2: Fly there and stop inside it. A calm hum marks the zone.
lesson.move-stop.goal.1: Fly to the zone and stop inside it.
lesson.move-stop.retry: Let's try again. Slow down early.
lesson.move-stop.hint.1: Slow down before you arrive. The hum repeats faster when you are close.
lesson.walls-hall.title: The big hall
lesson.walls-hall.intro.1: You are in a big, empty hall. The walls, the floor and the ceiling make knocks, thuds and puffs when you come near.
lesson.walls-hall.intro.2: Fly toward a wall and stop before you touch it. The knocks speed up as you get close.
lesson.walls-hall.intro.3: If you do touch it, nothing breaks. It is only a soft bump.
lesson.walls-hall.goal.1: Fly to each wall and stop before you touch it.
lesson.walls-hall.pass: You stopped in front of every wall.
lesson.walls-hall.retry: Let's try again. Slow down early.
lesson.walls-hall.hint.1: Fast knocks mean you are close. Slow down as soon as the knocks start.
lesson.walls-pillar.title: Around a pillar
lesson.walls-pillar.intro.1: There is one pillar in the hall. It has its own metal tick.
lesson.walls-pillar.intro.2: Fly all the way around it without touching it.
lesson.walls-pillar.hint.1: Keep the tick on one side and move around it in a big, calm circle.
lesson.walls-row.title: A row of pillars
lesson.walls-row.intro.1: Now there are several pillars in a row. Fly between them.
lesson.walls-row.intro.2: Listen to the ticks on your left and on your right. Stay in the middle of the gap.
lesson.walls-row.goal.1: Fly through the row without touching a pillar.
lesson.walls-row.pass: You flew through the whole row.
lesson.walls-row.hint.1: If the ticks are louder on one side, move toward the other side.
lesson.corridor.title: The long corridor
lesson.corridor.intro.1: This is a long corridor. The walls are close on both sides.
lesson.corridor.intro.2: Stay in the middle. If the knocks are louder on one side, move away from that side.
lesson.corridor.intro.3: There are checkpoints along the way. If you touch a wall, you go back to the last checkpoint.
lesson.corridor.goal.2: Then follow the bends: left and right, up and down.
lesson.corridor.retry: Let's try again from the last checkpoint.
lesson.corridor.hint.1: Slow down before a bend. The knocks tell you where the wall is.
lesson.rings-first.title: Your first ring
lesson.rings-first.intro.1: Now the ring. A low hum comes from the middle of the ring. Fly toward the hum.
lesson.rings-first.intro.2: If the hum is smooth, you are lined up. If it is rough, you are off to one side. Steer until it is smooth.
lesson.rings-first.intro.3: When you pass through the ring, you hear a bright note.
lesson.rings-first.retry: Let's try again. Line up first.
lesson.rings-first.hint.1: Turn until the hum is straight ahead, then fly in.
lesson.rings-line.title: Rings in a line
lesson.rings-line.intro.1: Now there are two or three rings in a row, and then some with a turn.
lesson.rings-line.intro.2: Each note is higher than the last, like a little song.
lesson.rings-line.goal.1: Fly through all the rings, in order.
lesson.rings-line.hint.1: After each ring, listen for the next hum and turn toward it.
lesson.rings-small.title: Smaller rings
lesson.rings-small.intro.1: The rings get smaller each time. You have to be more exact.
lesson.rings-small.intro.2: Go slower and make small corrections.
lesson.rings-small.goal.1: Fly through the rings, even the smallest.
lesson.rings-small.retry: Let's try again, a little slower.
lesson.rings-small.hint.1: A smooth hum straight ahead means you will fit.
lesson.rings-course.title: A ring course
lesson.rings-course.intro.1: A course of several rings, with turns and changes of height.
lesson.rings-course.intro.2: Follow the hum from ring to ring. The last ring finishes the song.
lesson.rings-course.goal.1: Fly through every ring without touching anything.
lesson.rings-course.hint.1: Don't rush. Smooth first, fast later.
lesson.shapes-square.title: The square gate
lesson.shapes-square.intro.1: A square gate has four bars. Its sound ticks at each corner.
lesson.shapes-square.intro.2: Fly through the middle of it.
lesson.shapes-square.hint.1: The four ticks mark the corners. Aim for the middle between them.
lesson.shapes-series.title: A series of squares
lesson.shapes-series.intro.1: Several squares in a row, turning a little.
lesson.shapes-series.goal.1: Fly through all the squares, in order.
lesson.shapes-series.hint.1: After each square, find the next one before you speed up.
lesson.shapes-cube.title: The cube frame
lesson.shapes-cube.intro.1: A cube frame is a box made of bars, open on every side. Its sound jumps between the front and the back.
lesson.shapes-cube.intro.2: Fly in through the front and out through the back.
lesson.shapes-cube.intro.3: Afterwards I will ask you what shape it was. You may skip that question.
lesson.shapes-cube.goal.1: Fly through the cube frame, then name its shape.
lesson.shapes-cube.hint.1: The sound alternates between front and back. Between them, you are inside the cube.
lesson.free-garden.title: Free flight in the Winter Garden
lesson.free-garden.intro.1: This is the Winter Garden, a real place that was scanned in 3D. A chain of rings leads you through it.
lesson.free-garden.intro.2: Follow the hum from ring to ring. Your time is measured.
lesson.free-garden.intro.3: Fly smoothly. The fastest clean flight wins.
lesson.free-garden.goal.1: Fly through the chain of rings as fast as you can, without touching a wall.
lesson.free-garden.hint.1: Plan your next turn while you pass the ring.
glossary.intro: I will name each sound you will meet and then play it. Listen to how it changes.
glossary.done: That was every sound. You can hear them again at any time.
glossary.again: Press {key} to hear the sounds again.
headphones.intro: Put your headphones on. The side marked L goes on your left ear.
headphones.q-side: Where is this sound? Press 1 for left, 2 for right, 3 if you are not sure.
headphones.q-front-back: Is this sound in front of you or behind you? Press 1 for in front, 2 for behind, 3 if you are not sure.
headphones.swapped: It seems left and right are swapped. Check which ear each side is on.
headphones.unclear: I could not tell left from right. Check that the plug is in all the way and the volume is on.
headphones.wired: Wired headphones work best. Bluetooth headphones add a delay.
headphones.volume: Keep the volume comfortable. If a sound is too loud, turn it down.
headphones.os-spatial: Please switch off Windows Sonic, Atmos and other surround effects. They change the sound.
quiz.howto: Answer with the number keys, or say the number.
quiz.q-moving: Is it moving? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
quiz.where-options: Press 1 for left, 2 for right, 3 for in front, 4 for behind.
menu.welcome: Welcome to Fly by Sound. Move through the menu with the arrow keys or the stick. Press Enter or button one to choose. Press Escape to go back.
menu.main.title: Main menu
menu.lessons.title: Lessons
menu.path.fast-what: A short way: hover, walls, a corridor and rings.
menu.settings.title: Settings
menu.setting.calm-what: Calm mode makes every sound softer and slower.
menu.value.heading: the way you face
menu.hearing-note: Keep the volume comfortable. If a sound hurts, take off the headphones and turn the volume down.
help.record: Press {key} to start or stop recording.
help.send: Press {key} to send the flight to the author.
help.status: Press {key} to hear where you are.
help.repeat: Press {key} to hear the last line again.
help.glossary: Press {key} to open the sound glossary.
help.reset: Press {key} to go back to the last checkpoint. Hold it to start the lesson again.
help.next: Press {key} to go to the next step.
help.digits: Use the number keys to answer a question.
rec.ask: May I record this flight and your voice? The recording stays on this device until you send it. Press {key} to say yes.
rec.mic-denied: The microphone is not allowed, so I will record the flight without your voice.
rec.minor: You are under 18, so a parent or guardian must have signed the consent form. Your helper confirms this.
rec.saved: The flight is saved on this device.
rec.recover: An earlier flight was not finished. Press {key} to keep it.
send.ask: Press {key} to send this flight to the author.
send.confirm: Do you agree to send the recording, with your voice, to the author? Press {key} to agree.
send.stored: The server has your flight. Now it goes to the author.
send.delivered: Delivered. The author got your flight by Telegram and by e-mail. Thank you.
send.partial-telegram: The author got it by Telegram only. E-mail will try again.
send.partial-email: The author got it by e-mail only. Telegram will try again.
send.failed: Sending did not work. Your flight is safe on this device. I will try again.
send.by-voice: You can also say: send it to the author.
send.speech-note: Voice commands use your browser's speech recognition, which sends audio to the browser's maker. The keys always work.
send.none: There is no recording to send.
send.cancelled: Not sent. Your flight stays on this device.
status.progress: Lesson {lesson} of {lessons}: {title}. Step {step} of {steps}. Attempt {n}. Counted {counted} of {required}.
fly.wrong-way: You are flying back. Turn around.
fly.wrong-side: That gate was passed from the wrong side. Go back and fly it from the front.
fly.lesson-passed: Lesson passed. Next, a bit harder: {title}.
fly.last-lesson: Lesson passed. That was the last lesson.
fly.offer-next: Press {key} to go on to the next lesson.
fly.moving-on: Let's go on to the next lesson.

reason.height-low: Too low {percent} percent of the time.
reason.turn-hold: The sound was in front. Stop turning when it is in the middle.
reason.turn-behind: The sound was behind you. Turn until it is in front.
reason.turn-left: The sound was still {degrees} degrees to the left.
reason.turn-right: The sound was still {degrees} degrees to the right.
reason.zone-past: Past the zone by {metres, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}}.
reason.zone-short: Stopped {metres, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}} short of the zone.
reason.zone-no-stop: In the zone, but no stop there.
reason.stop-far: Stopped {metres, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}} away. Stop within {limit, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}}.
reason.around: Only {degrees} degrees of the full circle.
reason.distance: {metres} of {total, plural, one {# metre} other {# metres}} flown.
survey.intro.first: I have a few short questions about your first flight. There are no wrong answers.
survey.intro.returning: I have a few short questions about how flying by sound is going for you.
survey.intro.child: Let's play a question game about what you just did. There are no wrong answers.
survey.mic-on: The microphone stays on while you answer, so your words stay with the flight. It turns off after the last question.
survey.offer: Do you want to answer a few questions? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
survey.howto: Answer with a number key. Press {skip} to skip a question.
survey.howto-voice: Answer with a number key, or say the number. Press {skip} to skip a question.
survey.repeat-hint: Press {key} to hear the question again.
survey.open-howto: Say your answer out loud. Press {key} when you are done.
survey.thanks: Thank you. That helps a lot.
survey.item.fun: How much did you enjoy flying by sound?
survey.item.mental: How hard did you have to think?
survey.item.frustration: How annoyed or stressed did you feel?
survey.item.fear: How afraid were you of hitting something?
survey.item.up-direction: When the drone goes up, which sound did you expect?
survey.item.ears-tired: Did your ears get tired, or did a sound bother you?
survey.item.helped: Which sound helped you most? Say it out loud.
survey.item.annoyed: Which sound bothered you or was confusing? Say it out loud.
survey.item.performance: How well do you think you did?
survey.item.effort: How hard did you have to work to do that well?
survey.item.learned-quickly: I learned to fly by sound quickly.
survey.item.confident: I feel confident flying by sound.
survey.item.came-back: Did you come back because you wanted to?
survey.item.turned-off: Did you turn any sound down or off? Say which one, and why.
survey.item.change: What should we change? Say it out loud.
survey.item.child-fun: How much fun was it? 1 is boring, 5 is the best.
survey.item.child-again-flying: Would you like to fly again?
survey.item.child-again-walls: Would you like to find walls by sound again?
survey.item.child-again-rings: Would you like to fly through rings again?
survey.item.child-liked-best: What did you like best? Tell me.
